text: Game crashes every time I complete level 12. Lost all my progress. Completely unplayable.
Love this game but it freezes and crashes right after finishing level 12. Please fix ASAP!
Been stuck for 3 days. Beat level 12, app crashes, back to level 11. This is so frustrating.
Tried reinstalling 4 times. Still crashes on level 12. Waste of my storage.
The level 12 bug has been there for 2 weeks now. Dev team needs to get it together.
Игра вылетает после 12-го уровня каждый раз. Невозможно играть.
Crashed 6 times trying to get past level 12. I give up.
Everything works great UNTIL level 12. Then boom, force close every time.
My daughter is heartbroken because the app crashes after she beats level 12. Fix this please.
Level 12 crash bug. How is this not fixed yet? Must be a known issue.
I would give 5 stars but the crash on level 12 makes the game unplayable. 1 star until fixed.
Same crash on level 12 everyone else reports. Disappointing from an otherwise great game.
Почему никто не чинит баг с вылетом на 12 уровне?? Это же очевидно!
Passes all levels fine until 12. Developers please address the crash bug.
Three stars docked for the level 12 crash. Otherwise would be 5 stars. Waiting for update.
5 lives and then a 30-minute wait? This isn't 2015. The energy system ruins an otherwise fun game.
I run out of lives in 5 minutes and then have to wait half an hour. Who designs this?
Energy system is brutal. Remove it or at least reduce the wait time to 10 minutes.
Had 3 stars, then ran out of energy. Now waiting 150 minutes. Great game design /s.
The wait times kill the fun dead. I fall asleep before my energy refills.
5 hearts that recharge at 1 per 30 min = 2.5 hours for a full refill. Absolutely not.
If not for the energy timer I'd play this all day. The monetization ruins a good game.
Система жизней — это кошмар. 5 жизней на 10 минут и потом ждёшь час.
Who thought 30 mins per life was acceptable? Please reduce to 10 mins at least.
Every time I get into the flow, I run out of lives. Can't play for more than 10 minutes.
Energy system = forced ads. I see the game mechanics clearly now.
My kids cry when the lives run out. The timer is 30 minutes. That's just cruel.
No energy system = 5 stars. With energy system = 2 stars. Simple math.
1 life every 30 minutes means I need 2.5 hours to refill from zero. This game doesn't respect my time.
The game would be perfect without the artificial life gate. Remove it and charge a one-time fee instead.
Energy timer makes the game unplayable for people who want to play for more than 5 minutes straight.
30 minutes per life is highway robbery. At least make it 10 minutes like other games.
Waiting 2.5 hours for full energy is insane. I find another game to play and forget this one.
The energy refill timer is what's stopping this from being my #1 game. So frustrating.
Life system exists only to push IAP. Transparent and annoying.
$9.99 for a 'starter pack' that runs out in a day? Hard pass.
The starter pack is a ripoff. 500 gems for $10 won't even get you past one hard level.
Bought the starter pack thinking it was good value. Used it all in 2 hours. Never again.
9.99 for a starter pack? That's a AAA price for mobile garbage.
The starter offer popup appears every session. And at $9.99 it's not even a deal.
Compare $9.99 starter pack here vs $4.99 anywhere else — terrible value.
Starter pack is overpriced at $10. Would buy at $2.99.
Пакет новичка за 10 долларов — это грабёж. Не стоит своих денег вообще.
The 'exclusive' starter offer reappears every update. And it's still $10. No thanks.
Hard to justify $9.99 when the game is free. The pack should be $1.99 max.
Bought the starter pack, completed it in one evening. $10 wasted.
They show you the starter pack every time you open the app. It's $9.99. That's not a deal.
If the starter pack was $3-4 I'd buy it immediately. At $10 it's a no.
The gems in the starter pack barely cover two continues. At $9.99, that's a joke.
Great game but the monetization is designed to extract money, not enhance gameplay. The $9.99 pack is exhibit A.
An ad after EVERY level. That's not monetization, that's harassment.
I counted: 8 unskippable ads in a 20-minute session. Uninstalled.
The game forces a 30-second ad after every single level. It makes the game unplayable.
Ads every level break the flow completely. I'd pay to remove them but the ad-free option is too expensive.
30-second unskippable ads after every level. The game is literally 50% ads by time.
Put the game down because of ads. Can't believe this passes app store review.
Реклама после каждого уровня — невозможно играть. Удалил.
The ads are longer than the actual levels. Something is very wrong with this monetization.
Skip ad button appears at 5 seconds but the ad is 30 seconds. So you have to watch 25 more. Evil.
No way to remove ads without spending money. And the ad-free price isn't shown anywhere.
Watching an ad after every level destroys the flow state. This is why people use ad blockers.
Ads are invasive and frequent. Level up = ad. Life refill = ad. Everything = ad.
Deleted the game because of ad frequency. Otherwise loved it.
Every. Single. Level. Ad. I don't understand how the developers think this is acceptable.
If ads appeared every 5 levels it would be tolerable. After every level it's abuse.
Please add a guild system! I want to play with my friends.
The game is great but needs multiplayer. A guild war mode would make it legendary.
5 stars if they add PvP. Right now it's missing the competitive element.
I'd spend money on this game if there were guilds and leaderboards. Add social features please!
Love the puzzle mechanics but the game feels lonely without a community feature.
Need guild functionality asap. My whole friend group plays but we can't interact.
PvP mode please! The base game is excellent, it just needs competition.
Would be a 10/10 game with guild wars. The puzzle engine is perfect for PvP.
Requesting: friends list, guild, weekly tournaments. This game deserves social features.
The match-3 mechanics are perfect for competitive play. When is PvP coming?
Absolutely love this game. The graphics are stunning and the puzzles are perfectly balanced.
Best match-3 game I've played in years. Incredibly addictive and visually gorgeous.
Candy Kingdoms is my go-to stress relief. The level design is creative and satisfying.
This game is beautiful. The animations are smooth, the colors are vivid. 10/10 presentation.
If not for the bugs, this would be a perfect game. The core gameplay is exceptional.
